mainText: This is the Gaza Dispatch audio briefing for June 3, 2026. Here are the key source-backed developments from today's edition. 1. Zak Khan on Israeli detention after Gaza aid mission. The New Arab Meets: Zak Khan to speak more on the Gaza flotilla, his abuse in Israeli detention, and running as a Green Party candidate in the UK. This was reported by The New Arab. 2. Israel is building more military posts in Gaza, satellite imagery shows. An investigation by Al Jazeera has identified 40 distinct Israeli military outposts entrenched within Gaza. This was reported by Al Jazeera. 3. Israeli forces detain Birzeit University students near Ramallah. The latest arrests have drawn condemnation from church officials amid concerns over targeting of students and expanding West Bank raids. This was reported by The New Arab. 4. UK Lawyers for Israel face scrutiny over intimidation tactics. Since its creation, the group has employed what its critics describe as "lawfare" against Israel's opponents and critics, or supporters of Palestine. This was reported by The New Arab. 5. Can mediators rescue.
